# observe_notification_channel (Resource)

Where alerts go. Secrets (webhook URLs, tokens, keys) are write-only: the API never returns them, so an imported channel needs them set again in configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "observe_notification_channel" "slack" {
  type        = "slack"
  label       = "#ops"
  webhook_url = var.slack_webhook_url
}

resource "observe_notification_channel" "incident_bot" {
  type        = "webhook"
  label       = "Incident bot"
  webhook_url = "https://hooks.example.com/observe"
  event_types = ["uptime_incident_opened", "uptime_incident_resolved"]
}

variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `type` (String) Channel type, e.g. `email`, `slack`, `discord`, `teams`, `webhook`, `pagerduty`, `opsgenie`, `telegram`, `ntfy`, `pushover`. The API reference lists them all, with the fields each one needs.

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) opsgenie and jsm (Jira Service Management Operations, Opsgenie's successor): the API integration key. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) pushover: application token; gotify: application token. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) telegram. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `category_modes` (Map of String) Per event category: immediate, digest or off
- `chat_id` (String) telegram. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `delivery_hours` (String) One of `always`, `business`, `outside`.
- `email` (String) email: a fixed address when use_org_recipients is false. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `eu_region` (Boolean) opsgenie: api.eu.opsgenie.com. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `event_types` (List of String) Only these events; omit (or all_events: true) for every event
- `headers` (String, Sensitive) webhook: extra request headers, one "Name: value" per line (not Host, Content-*, Observe-Signature). Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `label` (String)
- `organization_id` (String) Organization ID; defaults to the provider's `organization_id`
- `payload_template` (String) webhook: JSON body with placeholders inside strings: {{event_type}}, {{title}}, {{message}}, {{status}}, {{site_url}}, {{site_label}}, {{monitor_url}}, {{incident_id}}, {{organization}}, {{timestamp}}. Blank sends the standard payload. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `priority` (String) opsgenie and jsm: auto (P1 for critical monitors, else P3) or a fixed priority. One of `auto`, `P1`, `P2`, `P3`, `P4`, `P5`. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `quiet_hours_end` (String) H:i
- `quiet_hours_start` (String) H:i
- `responder_team` (String) opsgenie and jsm: team that receives the alert (default: the integration's team). Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `routing_key` (String, Sensitive) pagerduty. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `server_url` (String) ntfy: your own server (default ntfy.sh); gotify: your server (https, required). Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `tag_filter` (List of String) Only monitors with any of these tags
- `team_id` (String) Only alerts for this team's monitors
- `topic` (String) ntfy. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `use_org_recipients` (Boolean) email: send to the organization's owners and admins (default). Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `user_key` (String, Sensitive) pushover. Write-only: the API does not return it.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) slack, discord, teams, googlechat, mattermost, rocketchat (https only) and webhook. Write-only: the API does not return it.

### Read-Only

- `destination` (String) The address, topic or host alerts go to
- `id` (String) ID
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) webhook: the key for the Observe-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <organization_id>/<id>, or <id> when the provider sets organization_id
terraform import observe_notification_channel.example 01JCX4ZK7N2Q8V3W5Y6A9B0C1D/01JCX5A2B3C4D5E6F7G8H9J0K1
```
